name: Shoulder blade squeeze
summary: Draw the shoulder blades together and down, as if pinching a pencil between them.
setup: Sit or stand tall. Squeeze the shoulder blades toward each other and slightly down, hold five seconds, relax.
why: The blades move on the back, out of sight of a phone in front. A back-on view sees only a small change. Logged by hand.
progression: Add a light band held in front; progress to rows.
contraindications: Sharp pain between the shoulder blades.

faults.label: Shrugging up
faults.tip: The blades go together and down. If the shoulders rise toward the ears, the upper trapezius has taken over.

faults.label: Letting go too soon
faults.tip: These are endurance muscles. Short holds do not reach them.

faults.label: Arching the lower back
faults.tip: The squeeze happens between the blades, not by throwing the chest forward.

faults.label: Squeezing too hard
faults.tip: A gentle set is what these muscles need; a maximal squeeze recruits the neck.

points.t: Blades together and down; shoulders stay low.
Tall, ribs stacked over the hips.
